patch.value: beads validate and beads diff fail to register on pm-cli 2026.7.27 because each redeclares the host-owned --json global

pm-cli 2026.7.27 (GH-719) makes the host reject any extension command whose flags shadow a host-owned global flag. beads validate and beads diff both declared { long: "--json" } in their flags arrays (VALIDATE_FLAGS and DIFF_FLAGS), so both commands failed to register against a real pm host. The suite never caught this because every smoke test built a hand-rolled api double that accepts all registrations unconditionally. Additionally, the audit:prod script used a bare 'npm audit --omit=dev' that fails with EALLOWSCRIPTS in project-scoped installs. Fix: drop both --json flag declarations, read the value from ctx.global.json in parseDiffOptions and the validate handler, rebuild the smoke suite on the SDK createExtensionTestHarness so pm's real activation engine validates registration, add a suite-wide guard, and fix audit:prod to strip npm_config_allow_scripts.

value.author: pi-agent
value.text: Verified end-to-end: activation probe prints failed=[]; full suite 85/85 pass; release:check green. Also fixed pre-existing audit:prod EALLOWSCRIPTS bug.

patch.value: Both commands re-register on pm-cli 2026.7.27 after dropping the shadowing --json declaration. Left unattributed on purpose: backdating it into 2026.7.27 would claim a cut release contained a fix it does not.
beads validate and beads diff register successfully under pm-cli 2026.7.27, with the changelog entry under Unreleased until the next release is cut.

Before the fix, redeclaring the host-owned --json global aborted registration at that command and dropped every later sibling, while --help still exited 0 with a misleading arity error (upstream pm-cli#772).

Retired as shipped: the fix stopping beads validate and beads diff from shadowing the host-owned --json global merged today as PR #51, restoring registration under pm-cli 2026.7.27. Deliberately closed with NO release attribution, because the v2026.7.27 tag was cut before that merge -- the fix is genuinely unreleased and belongs in the Unreleased section.
